newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Indices slip on Ivorian Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Indices slip on Ivorian Bourse.

text.p: Share indices on Ivory Coast's Stock Exchange slipped in the week to Friday, its market report showed.
The BVA All-Share Index fell 0.46 percent to 361.49 points, taking the 1996 rise to 30.38 percent.
The 12VB 12-share index fell 0.21 percent to 251.33 points from last week's record 251.85 points. The rise on the year is 26.13 percent.
Turnover was 26,280 shares, of which 19,238 were for bank SGBCI. This compared with turnover of 10,297 the previous week and 5,133 the week before.
The value of shares traded was 467,717,000 CFA francs compared with 173,701,000 CFA the previous week.
SGBCI closed unchanged at 13,800 CFA francs. Cable company SICABLE closed down 700 CFA at 21,500, shippers SDV-CI fell 640 CFA to 13,750 and rubber company SOGB slipped 500 CFA to 13,500.
The BVA index stood at 277.25 points at the end of 1995, the 12VB at 199.26 points.
The Abidjan bourse recorded a 78.57 percent rise in market capitalisation to 400 billion CFA in 1995.
